synth.notes:
Two cyan blocks (left/wall_15, right/hazard_8) move together: A1/A2 y-/+4, A3 apart, A4 together; each is blocked by its half bounds, maze cells and marker cells.
Clicking an inactive marker arms the blocks (color_1 players) and activates it (color_11); A1-A4 then move the active marker by 4. Clicking a player disarms. Clicks on active markers or blocks, and A5, do nothing.
Timer bars (color_0, top-right and bottom-left) have w=floor(3(n+1)/7), n = actions since level start; tracked via a continuity-gated counter, fallback = smallest n for that width.
Names = type_color_rank by (y,x), starting at 2 in block mode (block_left/right are separate) and at 0 in armed mode.
Not confirmed: maze cells beyond {(6,18),(14,38),(38,14)} were never observed; marker bounds assumed [2,58].
